name: Commit Check
uses: Policy-as-code checks for commit messages, authors, branches, force pushes, file size and forbidden paths, with stable rule IDs in JSON, for hooks, CI, an API and an MCP server.
features: one cchk.toml for hook, CI, API and MCP
author, message, branch and path rules
JSON output with stable rule IDs
next_gate: Trial commit-check --message --author-name --author-email --files --format json under $PFY_TMP over recent main commits next to check_public_paths.py, counting real catches and false positives. No GitHub App, no hooks in the operator checkout, no --fix on pushed commits. No Feature GO.
